description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayChannel component in a macOS application, focusing on WebSocket connection behaviors including concurrent connection handling and error scenarios.

classes.name: GatewayChannelConnectTests
classes.description: A test suite for the GatewayChannel component, verifying connection behavior and error handling.

methods.name: concurrent connect is single flight on success
methods.description: Tests that multiple concurrent connect calls on a GatewayChannel result in only a single WebSocket connection attempt when successful.

methods.name: concurrent connect shares failure
methods.description: Ensures that concurrent connect attempts correctly handle failures and do not produce multiple failure states.

methods.name: connect surfaces structured auth failure
methods.description: Verifies that a structured authentication failure is correctly reported with detailed error information.
